$comment: Every email in emails/: its id (emails/<id>.mjml + emails/<id>.props.json), type (transactional: account and order emails people need; marketing: newsletters and announcements, which must carry an unsubscribe link), subject and preheader (the grey line after the subject in the inbox). Both may use the same {{data}} as the email.

emails.subject: Welcome to {{brand.name}}, {{user.firstName}}
emails.preheader: Three small steps to your first shared board, and where to find help.

emails.subject: Confirm your email address
emails.preheader: One click to confirm {{recipient.email}}. The link works for {{expiresInHours}} hours.
emails.about: Sent after sign-up or an email change; the account is limited until it's confirmed.

emails.subject: Reset your {{brand.name}} password
emails.preheader: Someone asked to reset your password. The link expires in {{expiresInMinutes}} minutes.
emails.about: Sent when someone asks for a password reset.

emails.subject: Your {{brand.name}} sign-in link
emails.preheader: Sign in with one click, or type the code {{code}}. Expires in {{expiresInMinutes}} minutes.
emails.about: Passwordless sign-in: a one-time link and code.

emails.subject: Your receipt for {{money receipt.total receipt.currency}} ({{receipt.number}})
emails.preheader: Paid {{date receipt.paidAt}} with {{receipt.paymentMethod}}. Your invoice PDF is one click away.
emails.about: Sent after every successful payment: subscription renewals and one-off orders.

emails.subject: Your trial ends in {{plural daysLeft "day" "days"}}
emails.preheader: Pick a plan to keep everything as it is. Nothing is deleted either way.
emails.about: Sent 3 days before a free trial ends.

emails.subject: Your order {{order.number}} is on its way
emails.preheader: {{order.carrier}} expects to deliver it on {{date order.estimatedDelivery}}. Track it any time.
emails.about: Sent when a shop order leaves the warehouse.

emails.subject: {{inviter.name}} invited you to {{workspace.name}} on {{brand.name}}
emails.preheader: Join the workspace to see its boards. The invitation is valid for {{expiresInDays}} days.
emails.about: Sent when a workspace member invites someone by email.

emails.subject: {{issue.title}}
emails.about: The monthly newsletter: a lead story, two shorter ones and a tip.
